detail.longDescription: Share your information if you are looking for work. Please use this format: Location: Remote: Willing to relocate: Technologies: Résumé/CV: Email: Please only post if you are personally looking for work. Agencies, recruiters, job boards, and so on, are off topic here. Readers: please only email these addresses to discuss work opportunities. Searchers: try https://nthesis.ai/public/hn-wants-to-be-hired , https://www.wantstobehired.com .
